items.title: Remove the legacy koala activity-log reader and its path constant
items.context: packages/main/src/core/activity-log.ts and lattice-paths.ts LATTICE_LEGACY_KOALA_ACTIVITY_LOG / activity.legacy-koala.jsonl; stop reading the legacy log.

happy.desc: grep -r LATTICE_LEGACY_KOALA_ACTIVITY_LOG packages/main/src/ -> zero hits; WHY: the path constant is fully removed from product code
grep -r getMigratedLegacyKoalaActivityLogPath packages/main/src/ -> zero hits; WHY: the legacy archive reader function is fully removed
readActivityLogTail(projectRoot, 50) with only .lattice/activity.jsonl present -> returns entries sorted desc, no crash; WHY: normal-path still works after legacy source removal

edge.desc: readActivityLogTail(projectRoot, 1) when .lattice/activity.jsonl does not exist and legacy-koala.jsonl does not exist -> returns [] without error; WHY: boundary where no log files exist at all must not crash after removing the legacy source

stale-detector lastActivityTimestamp(root) with only runtime activity.jsonl (no legacy archive) -> returns correct timestamp from runtime log; WHY: stale-detector was a known consumer of the legacy archive via readActivityLogTail; must still work

adversarial.desc: grep -rn activity.legacy-koala packages/main/src/ -> zero hits outside comments/changelogs; WHY: ensure no orphan string reference to the legacy filename survives that could cause a runtime file-not-found or silent data loss

runtime-artifact-registry.ts no longer lists activity.legacy-koala.jsonl in ignorePatterns or exact matches -> confirmed removed; WHY: stale ignore-pattern for a deleted file could mask future file-path collisions
